what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 14769 Pakistani refugees in the United Kingdom, 16.3% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level in some years, with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 211 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
